correctness.rationale: Lower bounds follow from incident-edge distinctness, the rainbow C4 requirement, and odd-cycle parity. The block-cut construction supplies the matching upper bound with explicit palette counts at every cut vertex. Every cycle of a cactus lies in one block, so the construction checks all C4 constraints. An exact conflict-graph census of 6074 labeled cacti of orders 2 through 6 agrees with the formula.

value.rationale: Cactus graphs are a standard natural subclass of outerplanar graphs. The result is a complete exact classification, not a routine parameter increment or arbitrary finite case. It proves degree-optimal B-colorability for every cactus from the sharp threshold Delta=4 and identifies the only low-degree obstructions.
